subject: Initial commit
summary: A robot battle becomes a way to learn how programs work.

files.role: Introduces the project and its learning goal.

excerpts.note: The project starts with two promises: write a robot for a battle, then see how the program becomes instructions a machine can follow. This first page gives the reason for all the small steps that follow.

lines.text: A great way to learn about programming with a simple Ruby-like syntax. Write programs to battle
it out with other programs on a virtual battlefield. Then, learn about how programming languages
turn your code into instructions a machine can understand.

after.text: Inspired by [CROBOTS - a programming game, for programmers, or aspiring programmers](http://tpoindex.github.io/crobots/),
the [Crystal Programming Language - A language for humans and computers](https://crystal-lang.org/),
`crystal-robots` is my exploration of depending on my own programming tools.
